What is still open is the grown elm's own winter habit, at every level including near: its branches run out as long, nearly straight strokes at the summer crown's drooping angles and cross one another, and it grows a few hundred twigs, where the print draws limbs that fork again and again into fine ascending twig, a dense fringe at each crown's rim. The flat crossing strokes are gone: the crowns at 15-44 m now read as rising Vs of twig as the print's do. Still open: the density. The print's crowns grey in with a fringe of hundreds of fine twigs each, where the mid ring (10-44 m, where most of this print's trees stand) can spend only the summer leaf's budget, a few dozen strokes a tree, so the render's crowns stay open against the sky.] [T-1934, 2026-11-01, re-rendered on spiked mid-ring twigs (tree-model.js spike, ELM_FRINGE.mid.spike): at the mid ring each fringe twig is now one three-sided spike from its foot to its tip (three triangles where the stroke spent six, its foot 0.02 m across so it covers about what the even stroke did), so the same summer-leaf budget draws twice the twigs: a grown parkway elm about 440 twigs at that ring where it drew about 220 (150 of its ~200 sprouts where it drew 73), the young elms 60-90 where they drew 30-45. The crowns at 15-44 m now grey in with more rising V's of twig. Still open: the print's crowns are denser yet, a few hundred fine twigs at each rim, and past 44 m (the far ring) a bare elm still draws its limbs and branches with no fringe.] [T-1934, 2026-11-01, re-rendered on the bare elm's own summer budget at the mid and far rings (tree-model.js: a bare elm at mid and far spends what its summer leaf there costs, elmShare's cards, and draws its skipped wood as spikes; ELM_FRINGE.far.spike and reserve): a grown parkway elm at the mid ring (10-44 m) now draws every one of its ~200 sprouts to its first fork and a share of the second, about 640 twigs where it drew about 450, still within its summer leaf's triangles (about 2,530 against 2,580); past 44 m (the far ring) it now draws a fringe twig off each limb tip it reaches, 11-12 a tree where it drew none, its skipped limbs and branches as spikes beside them, in the same 67 triangles as before. The crowns at 15-44 m grey in further and the far row carries rising twig over its limbs. Still open: the print's crowns are denser yet, hundreds of fine twigs at each rim, which the summer leaf's budget does not buy as geometry, most of all at the far ring (a dozen twigs a tree).]

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236). A ticket whose ## Image gate names this building does not close while it is not "matches" (tools/image_gate.mjs).
